 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Thierry Henry is regarded as one of the best strikers of his time, playing for Arsenal, Barcelona and France. Outside of the game, however, the former French international has created a private family life.
 The 1998 World Cup champion has four children and has been open about the impact of fatherhood on his life. His family has also been a significant influence in his life outside of professional soccer, especially as he moved from being an elite player to a coach and television analyst.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Who Is Thierry Henry's Wife? Inside His Relationship With Andrea Rajacic
 Since approximately 2008, Henry has been dating Bosnian model and business professional Andrea Rajacic. The couple has been relatively quiet about their relationship, though Rajacic has been seen with Henry at some high-profile events.
 Rajacic is a model, corporate sales professional, and business expert. She attended the University of Maryland, Washington, for business administration and went on to study in Spain. The couple has three children: Tristan, Tatiana, and Gabriel.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Prior to his relationship with Rajacic, Henry was married to English model Claire Merry (Nicole Merry). They were married in 2003 and had a daughter, Tea, in May 2005. They divorced in the late 2000s.
 While Rajacic is often referred to as Henry's wife in the media, recent profiles have called her his long-time partner, and a legal marriage between them has not been clearly reported in reliable sources.
 How Many Children Does Thierry Henry Have?
 Henry has four children: daughter Tea from his first marriage and three children with Rajacic. Their son Tristan was born in 2012, daughter Tatiana in 2015, and son Gabriel in 2016.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Thierry Henry, Andrea Rajacic and family attend BBC Sports Personality of the Year 2025 at Dock10 Studios.(Photo by Karwai Tang/WireImage)
 The former striker has spoken openly about the importance of his children. In a 2024 interview with The Diary of a CEO podcast, he shared how fatherhood had helped him see himself in a new light and how it had helped him through personal challenges.
 "My kids save me. They are saving me every day," Henry said, reflecting on the influence his children have had on his life.
 Who Are Thierry Henry's Parents?
 Henry was born in Les Ulis, France, to Antoine Henry and Maryse Henry. He is of Caribbean descent, his father being from Guadeloupe and his mother from Martinique.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Outside of soccer, Henry is a big-time basketball fan and has been to many NBA games. He has also established a broadcasting career, making him a familiar name in soccer broadcasting in the United States and Europe.
 Even though Henry is a world-famous player, he has been increasingly stressing the importance of family, and his identity is not just that of a player.
